text: 675 corrects the PluralForm.get getter documentation: the property returns the plural selector function, rather than taking aNum and aWords itself. The getter deletes itself and numForms, installs the pair returned by makeGetter, and returns PluralForm.get. makeGetter returns the selection function first and the count function second; a nearby older comment reverses that order. The log helper annotation says string, but implementation and callers also accept an array joined into a message. Proposed manual documentation rule: trace the returned function, tuple order and actual argument variants. PluralForm.sys.mjs is retired at the fixed accepted revision, so these are historical findings, not a current API recommendation.
title: Document a function-valued getter as returning a function
